newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Tuesday it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, to C$177.00/cubic metre or C$28.14/barrel, effective immediately.

Other new prices were listed as follows: Cromer light sour C$168.00/cubic metre, or C$26.71/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$140.00/cubic metre, or C$22.26/barrel Midale at Cromer C$154.00/cubic metre, or C$24.48/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
